target.description: Task Lens M1 completion across metrics/feedback, dual real-target integration, and dual-end acceptance closure.

in_scope: REQ-011v2 metrics and feedback integration: lock, append, recovery, validation, and summary
REQ-012v2 single-failure diagnostics and CLI wiring
REQ-013v2 fixture plus work-one and qoderwork real-target integration with zero-write verification
REQ-014v2 dual-end acceptance: ten unique task pairs, seven-of-ten useful-and-reduced gate, full tests, and typecheck exit 0
REQ-CROSS-ENV independent WSL and Windows Git Bash evidence with dual cases per requirement
gen2 outcome chain validation and canonical dual-end run result
out_of_scope: legacy audits/task-lens-m1/** historical paths as acceptance evidence
Windows or other operating-system behavior outside the WSL and Git Bash endpoints

allowed: creation of gen2 outcome artifacts under plans/task-lens-outcome-v1/
creation of isolated temporary test fixtures
prohibited: modification of legacy plans or blueprints

acceptance_strategy.objective: Validate the gen2 integration and dual-end acceptance contract with fixed test IDs, independent WSL and Windows Git Bash cases, and a canonical run result.
acceptance_strategy.acceptance: All expected cases must independently report PASS; the canonical verdict is PASS only when both endpoints pass every requirement.
